title: Celebrating the students who move campus forward
lead: OGA is the OGITECH Student Awards — a student-run celebration of leadership, creativity, academics and service.
story: OGA exists to recognise students whose work often goes unseen: the leaders, creators, scholars and builders who make campus life better for everyone.
Every edition is planned and delivered by a committee of students, with nominations, public voting and a ceremony that brings the community together.
